title: Heroku OAuth access token (HRKU-prefixed): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: the documented HRKU- prefix's dash replaced by an underscore (HRKU_); UUID and length unchanged. Twin of "Heroku OAuth access token (HRKU-prefixed): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
